value.description: A datacore of higher-level operating functions that bestow Mechanoids with full autonomy, necessary for decentralising processing overhead from the main hive.\n\nFormed over time by the Cerebrex core, a sapient Mechanoid can use this on another to bestow it full operational independence, allowing to operative without any form of controller, such as a Mechanitor or Gestalt Engine, and freely decide its own schedule, work types, and more.
Research the deployment of sapience protocols in mechanoid units, granting them full autonomy.
